name: Parzival
source:
Based on a knight from the Arthurian legend, [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Percival]Percival[/url], or Parzival in the German Arthurian literature. 
Parzival (this character) has a [url=/c9464]daughter[/url] called [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lohengrin]Lohengrin[/url], who is named after Parzival's son in the German Arthurian literature, who was also a knight of the round table.
